title: Phenomenal concepts may be hybrid and fail to refer

statements.text: A phenomenal concept may combine a general theoretical concept of a simple, intrinsic, immediately known property of experience with a recognitional concept for a type of sensory state. Since the recognitional capacity picks out a complex physical property, the hybrid concept fails to refer, and the theoretical concept may shape introspection so that sensory states are introspected as phenomenal.

sources.quote: Another possibility is that phenomenal concepts are hybrid ones.
